item.title: Re: Scrutiny of the assisted dying bill is vital but obstruction in the House of Lords could mean it never becomes law
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor The Terminally Ill Adults (End of Life) Bill is extremely controversial, but everyone agrees that this is exceptionally important legislation, and it is worth getting right. This bill changes the nature of the doctor-patient relationship, of the NHS, and of hospice, palliative and end-of-life care. It raises significant questions about safeguarding, medical ethics and public services. Any such momentous legislation would face a complex and difficult parliament

item.title: Re: Detained at the doctor’s office: US immigration policy endangers health
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor: Fear, although absent from clinical metrics and diagnostic algorithms, functions as a powerful and often invisible determinant of health. It shapes whether patients seek care, the timing of that care, and the severity of illness at presentation. In this way, fear alters clinical trajectories before any medical intervention occurs. Extensive public health research demonstrates that migration-related institutional environments can significantly influence health

item.title: Retaining the human in remote telesurgery
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor, In their paper, Wang et al. report one of the first randomised controlled trials comparing remote telesurgery versus local robotic surgery for radical urological surgery. The authors should be commended for undertaking such an ambitious, multicentre study. item.title: The worries about GCA overdiagnosis
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor It was very positive to see the educational focus on Giant Cell Arteritis (Education 7-14 February), and we completely agree that this is a medical emergency with devastating consequences, if missed. item.title: Never Forget SUFE in Adolescents with Knee Pain
item.description: Agreement: I AgreeBody: Dear Editor Chen et al. give an excellent and instructive account of Osgood-Schlatter's disease. item.title: Evidence and Ethics of Prostate Cancer Screening
